description: Clears three bytes and one word at fixed offsets of a record pointed to by the input.

name: allocate_message_port
description: Allocates memory and a signal bit through exec functions, initialises a message port structure with a type code and data pointer, and returns the port pointer or zero on failure.

name: free_message_port
description: If a port pointer is valid, runs a cleanup call when a field is set, marks two bytes with the maximum value, and frees the port's signal, memory and list entry through exec functions.

name: reset_cursor_offsets
description: Stores zero and 512 into two fields of the object state.

name: store_two_words_in_state
description: Stores two input words in fixed fields of the object state.

name: read_state_word_pair
description: Returns two sign-extended 16-bit words from fixed state fields, packed into a 64-bit result.

name: read_state_low_bits
description: Returns the low two bits of a state byte at a fixed offset.

name: update_clamped_cursor_position
description: Adds stored offsets to input coordinates, clamps the results to the screen area of 0 to 319 horizontally and 0 to 199 vertically, and updates status bytes for the new position.

name: update_joystick_velocity
description: Reads joystick movement and button state, decays stored velocity values toward zero by 300, applies acceleration and clamps the velocities, then stores them and a status flag back in state.

name: fill_state_word_with_ones
description: Sets a state word to all ones.

name: copy_record_list_from_globals
description: Appends five-word records copied from a global list onto the end of a buffer list, stopping at a terminator value of -1, and writes the terminator after the last record.

name: append_record_list_from_pointer
description: Appends five-word records copied from an input pointer to the end of a buffer list, stopping at a terminator value of -1 and writing a new terminator.

name: remove_matching_record_from_list
description: Searches a list of five-word records ending in a -1 sentinel for one whose last field matches the input value, then shifts the following records back over it.

name: append_rect_record_with_bounds
description: Appends a five-word record computed from the input values, clamping two of its fields at zero, and writes a -1 terminator after it.

name: append_record_with_offsets
description: Appends a five-word record computed from input values and two offsets, clamping two of its fields at zero, and writes a -1 terminator after it.

name: initialise_coordinate_table
description: Fills a block with 32-bit values derived from an input integer at a fixed spacing of 8000, and sets several offsets to fixed constants.

name: reset_object_runtime_state
description: Clears status and counter fields in the object, calls unnamed routines to set up sub-objects, and stores values into the object's pointer block.

name: reset_object_state_from_input
description: Stores the input word into the object, clears counters and state fields, and calls unnamed routines through the object's table to continue setup.

name: run_timed_update_loop
description: Runs a counted update loop, starting from 35000, that calls eight unnamed routines through a table, clears state bytes and stores a constant word before each pass.

name: initialise_program_subsystems
description: Points several globals at a shared default location, calls twenty-six unnamed routines to set up subsystems, writes flag bytes and references a short text string.

name: format_signed_decimal_text
description: Writes a signed 32-bit integer as decimal characters into a buffer, storing a minus sign for negative values and choosing digits by comparing against powers of ten.

name: write_decimal_digits_by_subtraction
description: Writes a 32-bit value as ten ASCII digits by repeatedly subtracting descending powers of ten and counting the subtractions for each digit.

name: store_bytes_and_walk_table
description: Stores two state bytes derived from inputs, calls unnamed routines, and walks a byte table, writing a function pointer and a doubled count into state.

name: format_eight_nibble_digits
description: Writes eight base-16 digit characters for a 32-bit input, rotating each four-bit group in turn and using letter forms for values above nine, then ends the string with a zero byte.

name: read_line_with_editing
description: Reads characters into a buffer, handling delete and backspace keys by removing the previous character, and ends when a carriage return is received.

name: edit_text_line_input
description: Edits a text line from keypresses, accepting letters, digits and some punctuation, echoing changes to the output and returning on a carriage return.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

name: parse_signed_decimal_text
description: Reads an optional minus sign and decimal digits from a character string and returns the signed value.

name: skip_decimal_digits
description: Advances a character pointer past any decimal digits and returns.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns without other work.
